title: DashboardError
description: Error body for every dashboard API endpoint, sent with a status >= 400.

error.description: invalid_request: 400. unauthorized: 401. not_found: 404. method_not_allowed: 405. payload_too_large: 413. internal: 500.

message.description: One-line, human-readable message. It never contains request values or credentials.

issues.description: Validation issues for an invalid request body, as reported by the contract parsers.

path.description: Dot path to the offending key; "" means the root.

message.description: What is wrong with the key; never contains request values.
